theater: 潘提卡帕翁與赫爾松涅斯

battle.name: 博斯普魯斯內戰
battle.theater: 潘提卡帕翁與赫爾松涅斯
battle.brief: 公元前311年前後，博斯普魯斯王國在斯基泰壓力下雇用希臘將領狄俄尼索斯，此人反噬雇主、奪走王國東岸數城，國王佩里斯阿德斯一世渡海逃往希臘城邦赫爾松涅斯，最後由密特里達斯一世收場。卡面的亞述長弓是黑海北岸弓箭體系的底層裝備，弓手齊射壓制敵陣、掩護重裝步兵上前的做法，延續到這場內戰。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場內戰發生在公元前311年前後的博斯普魯斯王國，首都潘提卡帕翁立於克里米亞東端的刻赤海峽北岸。交戰一方是斯巴達克王朝國王佩里斯阿德斯一世所代表的王國朝廷：軍隊由王國野戰兵、王室近衛，以及受雇於王室的瑪奧提人、西徐里騎射兵與希臘流亡傭兵混編而成，指揮權集中於國王與潘提卡帕翁的宮廷。另一方是僭首狄俄尼索斯率領的一支希臘語世界的流亡者與自由兵集團，其人數與編制皆無可靠記載，只知這支隊伍的首領善用攻城器械與封鎖手段，奪城之後就地徵用城內人力與糧食，性質更近於職業化的奪權集團而非正規軍隊。戰局牽涉三方：北面的西徐里部族聯盟，首領是奧克塔馬斯，以游牧騎兵威脅王國東部與黑海東岸；南面的希臘城邦赫爾松涅斯（陶里科赫爾松涅斯，即今日塞瓦斯托波爾一帶），採議事會與執政官體制，市民軍以重裝步兵為骨幹，倚城牆、港口與黑海航路自守。雙方共同的關鍵是博斯普魯斯海峽：它既隔開亞速海與黑海，也是王國財源與城邦存亡的樞紐。關於此事的文字記載極為殘缺，只能靠編年史殘篇、王國與城邦的錢幣、希臘文碑銘及陶器銘文互相對勘拼合，因此各方實力只能作定性描述，難以還原確切番號。
countriesEn: This civil war broke out in the Bosporan Kingdom around 311 BC. The kingdom's capital, Panticapaeum, stood on the northern shore of the Kerch Strait at the eastern tip of Crimea. One side was the court of King Paerisades I of the Spartocid dynasty: an army of royal levies, palace guards and a mixture of Maeotian, Scythian and Greek mercenary riders and archers in the king's pay, with command centred on the crown and the palace at Panticapaeum. The other side was the band of Greek-speaking exiles and free lances led by the usurper Dionysius of Halicarnassus; neither its numbers nor its organisation survive in any precise form, and what can be said is that its commander was skilled in siege works and in blockade, and that once he had taken a city he simply drew on its manpower and grain there, so that the force behaved more like a professional band of spoilers than a regular army. Two further parties shaped the war. To the north lay the Scythian tribal confederation of king Octamas, whose nomadic horsemen pressed on the eastern part of the kingdom and on the Black Sea shore. To the south lay the Greek polis of Chersonesus (Tauric Chersonesus, in the region of modern Sevastopol), organised as a council and a board of magistrates, with a citizen army in which hoplites formed the backbone, defended by walls, harbours and the Black Sea grain route. The pivot contested by everyone was the Cimmerian Bosporus: the strait that separates the Sea of Azov from the Black Sea and that carries the kingdom's revenue and the survival of the polis. The written record of the affair is extremely thin, and can only be reconstructed by collating fragments of chronicles, the coinage of kingdom and polis, Greek inscriptions and potters' marks. The strength of each side can therefore be described only in qualitative terms, and no reliable returns of numbers of men can be recovered.
people: 佩里斯阿德斯一世是斯巴達克王朝末期的君主之一，約公元前310年至303年在位，面對西徐里首領奧克塔馬斯自東北方南下施壓、以及王國對黑海航路與穀物出口的爭奪，選擇雇用一位名叫狄俄尼索斯的希臘將領。此人來自哈利卡納索斯，以斯巴達式的嚴厲紀律與個人權威控制流亡者隊伍，在對付西徐里騎兵時取得局部勝利，隨後轉而反噬雇主，奪走王國東岸數座城邑。佩里斯阿德斯一世率殘部西渡海峽，逃入赫爾松涅斯求助，最終死於那座城市；狄俄尼索斯則以暴君身分據守被奪的博斯普魯斯城市，用自己帶來的傭兵維持秩序，並覬覦王國的稅源與港口。赫爾松涅斯人既懼其吞併本土，又不願坐視海峽落入僭主手中，乃向黑海南岸求援：密特里達斯一世（克提斯忒斯），本出自色雷斯—本都系的貴族，因西徐里人逼迫而北來的流亡者，趁機以武力進入博斯普魯斯，藉婚姻與援助取得王位，成為密特里達斯王朝的奠基者。人物側寫中還有一批無名的群體：潘提卡帕翁的城守與近衛、赫爾松涅斯的執政官與重裝步兵、西徐里各部落的騎兵首領，以及雙方陣中的弓箭手、投槍手與持矛者——正是這些普通兵員，在殘缺記載裡構成了內戰的實際推力。
peopleEn: Paerisades I was one of the last monarchs of the Spartocid dynasty, reigning roughly from 310 to 303 BC. Pressed by the Scythian chief Octamas advancing from the north-east, and by the strain on the kingdom's share of the Black Sea shipping and grain exports, he hired a Greek commander named Dionysius, a man from Halicarnassus who held a band of exiles together with Spartan-style discipline and a reputation for personal authority. Dionysius first won local success against the Scythian horsemen, then turned on his employer and seized several Bosporan cities on the eastern side of the kingdom. Paerisades I gathered what was left of the royal levies and the palace guard, crossed the strait westward and fled for refuge to Chersonesus, where he died. Dionysius stayed on as a tyrant in the cities he had taken, holding them with his own mercenaries and taking a share of the kingdom's taxes and harbours. The Chersonesians, unwilling either to be swallowed nor to see the strait fall to a usurper, called in a strongman from the southern shore: Mithridates I (Ktistes), a Thracian-Pontic nobleman who had been driven north by the Scythians, who entered the Bosporus in force, obtained the throne by marriage and by force of arms, and became the founder of the Mithridatic dynasty. The rest of the cast is nameless but essential: the garrison of Panticapaeum, the magistrates and hoplites of Chersonesus, the mounted chiefs of the steppe clans, and the archers, javelin-throwers and pikemen who filled the ranks on both sides. These ordinary soldiers, not named kings, are what actually pushed the civil war along in the fragmentary record.
kits: 卡面這把亞述長弓，是理解這場內戰火力的基本單位。亞述式複合弓以角、木、筋三層疊合，短而有力，形制約六十至八十公分，箭長六十公分上下，箭鏃多為鐵質；黑海北岸的弓箭手——西徐里與瑪奧提的騎射手、希臘城邦的輕裝射手、雇傭軍中的弓箭手——在技術上正是這一系統的晚期使用者，而他們從亞述繼承來的是編排而非形制：弓手先以齊射壓制迫近之敵，掩護車兵與重裝步兵上前的傳統，一路延續到黑海沿岸。與弓手並列的是希臘步兵的裝備：大圓盾、短矛與刺槍、雙刃短劍、青銅頭盔，以及麻布與皮革製成的線衣鎧；城邦的重裝步兵靠方陣與盾牆作戰，輕裝的投槍手與弓箭手在兩翼及城牆上支援。防守一方另有希臘式的撞錘與臨時攻城塔、壕溝與拒馬，海上則靠帆船與划槳船維持黑海航線的糧道。馬匹是內戰中最重要的機動工具：西徐里騎兵用弓與長矛，重騎兵配長矛與彎刀，雙輪輕車則在東岸平原上作戰車射擊。卡面這把弓最值得留意之處，在於它象徵一套「遠程火力必須有車兵與重裝兵掩護才成立」的體系：內戰裡任何一方若失去城牆，或失去把弓手送到前沿的通道，手上的弓就淪為裝飾。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the basic unit of firepower for reading this war. The Assyrian composite bow is laminated from horn, wood and sinew, short but powerful, of a standard type about sixty to eighty centimetres long, with arrows around sixty centimetres and mostly iron heads. The archers of the northern Black Sea coast — Scythian and Maeotian horse archers, the light-armed skirmishers of the Greek poleis, the archers in the mercenary companies — were in technical terms late users of exactly this system, and what they inherited from Assyria was a doctrine of employment rather than a form: the archers shoot in mass to pin the enemy down and cover the advance of the chariots and the heavy infantry, a practice that ran on along the Black Sea coasts. Set beside the bow is the Greek infantryman's kit: the large round shield, the short spear and thrusting javelin, the double-edged short sword, bronze helmets, and body armour of linen and leather of the linothorax type. The hoplites of the poleis fought in phalanx behind the shield wall, with peltasts and archers supporting them on the flanks and from the walls. The defenders also had the Greek ram and improvised siege towers, ditches and sharpened obstacles, while at sea the grain route across the Black Sea was kept alive by sailing ships and galleys. Horses were the most important mobile asset in such a civil war: Scythian riders used bow and long spear, heavy cavalry carried the long spear and the curved sword, and light two-wheeled chariots were used for shooting on the plains of the eastern shore. What the card's bow shows most clearly is a system in which long-range firepower only works if chariots and heavy troops can be brought up behind it. In a civil war, any side that lost its walls, or lost the means of getting its archers to the front, was left holding a decoration.
tactics: 內戰的開局是典型的「以傭兵平外患」失敗後演成的叛亂：國王把防守東境的任務外包給狄俄尼索斯，傭兵隊伍深入王國腹地後反手奪取據點，靠的是奇襲、策反與夜襲，而非正面會戰的勝負。佩里斯阿德斯一世把殘餘的王國兵與近衛在西岸整頓，試圖以海峽為軸心重整防線，並向赫爾松涅斯求援，把城邦的城牆與船隊當作最後的支點。狄俄尼索斯一方則以圍城戰術取代野戰：奪城之後封鎖港口、控制糧道，逼守軍在補給耗盡後屈服，同時派遣騎兵巡邏草原，切斷對方援軍的陸路。海峽的制海權在此成為決定性變數——赫爾松涅斯的援軍必須由海路接近，傭兵方也必須靠船隊把兵員與攻城器械運上刻赤海峽北岸。最後扭轉局面的是聯盟外交：城邦聯手、黑海對岸的援軍登陸，以及進攻方內部的分裂，使狄俄尼索斯無法同時應付多個方向。作戰細節上，這類黑海內戰常見的組合是：弓手佔據城牆或居高位置射擊，步兵在盾牆後推進至有效射程，再以近身戰清場；草原上的遭遇戰則完全相反，靠騎射拉扯、迂回與斷糧，而非正面衝鋒。史料對具體戰役過程著墨極少，上述部署多由同時代的希臘兵書、僭主政治的常見模式與當地地形推想而來。
tacticsEn: The opening move was a classic rebellion born out of a failed outsourcing of a border defence. The king handed the task of holding the eastern frontier to Dionysius and his mercenaries, and once the mercenaries were deep inside the kingdom they turned and seized strongpoints by surprise, by turning garrisons and by night attack, rather than by winning a set-piece battle. Paerisades I tried to reform the line with the remnants of the royal levies and the palace guard, using the strait as the axis of a new defence, and he appealed to Chersonesus, treating the walls and the shipping of the polis as the last prop. Dionysius answered with blockade in place of open battle: after taking a city he closed its harbour, controlled the grain road and waited for the defenders to exhaust their supplies, while sending riders across the steppe to cut the land route by which relief would come. Command of the strait became decisive, because Chersonesian reinforcements could only approach by sea, and the mercenaries had to move men and siege equipment to the north shore of the Kerch Strait in their own shipping. What finally turned the situation was coalition diplomacy: the league of the poleis, reinforcements landing from the southern shore, and cracks inside the rebel camp meant Dionysius could no longer cover every front at once. In fighting detail, a Black Sea civil war of this kind usually combined archers on the walls or on rising ground with infantry advancing behind the shield wall to effective range, the melee finishing the business. Encounters on the steppe worked in the opposite way, through shooting, wheeling and the cutting of supplies rather than head-on charges. The sources say almost nothing about individual engagements, and the deployments described above are reconstructions from the artillery of the period, the usual pattern of usurper politics and the local terrain.
data: 關於兵力與損失，這場戰爭幾乎沒有可用的數字。可以確定的只有尺度與距離：博斯普魯斯王國的核心疆域在克里米亞南部，東抵亞速海北岸、北伸向高加索西麓，大約當今日克里米亞半島的三分之一至二分之一；刻赤海峽最窄處寬約四至六公里，潘提卡帕翁與赫爾松涅斯隔海相望，沿海航程約一百至一百五十公里，通常需要數日順風航行。時間軸同樣清晰：佩里斯阿德斯一世約於公元前310年至303年在位，動亂起於公元前311年前後，至密特里達斯王朝入主博斯普魯斯（約公元前310年至300年之間）方告收束；編年史家尤瑟比烏斯以奧林匹克四年期為框架為這段斷代。兵器尺度方面，亞述式複合弓形制約六十至八十公分，箭長約六十公分，鐵鏃通常在十至三十克上下；希臘重裝步兵的大圓盾直徑約九十至一百公分，全套裝備連武器約合二十公斤上下，單兵行軍每日約二十至三十公里，這些數字決定了糧道與援軍到場的時限。開戰的月份在任何文獻中都無記載，一般只能繫於春初的用兵季節。城邦人口、商船數量、雙方傭兵人數與戰損現存文獻都沒有留下可信記載，任何精確的傷亡數字都屬後人推估，不可當作史實。唯一能當作硬證據的，是希臘文錢幣與陶器銘文上出現的執政官名字，以及城邦議事紀錄中反覆出現的圍城與奪回字樣。
dataEn: Almost no usable figures survive for the armies or the losses of this war. What can be fixed are scale and distance. The core territory of the Bosporan Kingdom lay in southern Crimea, reaching the north shore of the Sea of Azov and stretching towards the western Caucasus, roughly a third to a half of the peninsula as it is today. The Kerch Strait is four to six kilometres wide at its narrowest, and Panticapaeum and Chersonesus face each other across about one hundred to one hundred and fifty kilometres of sea, a passage normally taking several days with a following wind. The chronology is equally firm: Paerisades I reigned from about 310 to 303 BC, the disturbance began around 311 BC, and the matter was not settled until the Mithridatic dynasty took the kingdom, between roughly 310 and 300 BC, and Eusebius, the chronicler, frames the whole period in Olympiad cycles of four years. As for the weapons, the Assyrian composite bow type runs about sixty to eighty centimetres, the arrow about sixty centimetres, and the iron head typically in the region of ten to thirty grams. A Greek hoplite's round shield is about ninety to a hundred centimetres in diameter, a hoplite's full equipment with weapons comes to some twenty kilograms, and a soldier on the march covers twenty to thirty kilometres a day; such figures set the limits on how long relief could take to arrive. The month in which the war opened is recorded nowhere, and it can only be attached to the spring campaigning season. The population of the polis, the number of merchant ships, the size of the mercenary companies and the casualties are simply not recorded in any usable form, and any precise casualty total is a later inference that must not be treated as fact. The only hard evidence that survives is the appearance of magistrates' names on the Greek coinage and on potters' marks, and the repeated references in the civic records of the polis to siege and to recovery.
cause: 內戰的起因是多層壓力同時爆發，而不是單一事件。第一層是外患：西徐里部族聯盟在首領奧克塔馬斯率領下南壓，逼近王國東境與黑海東岸的牧場及奴隸來源線。第二層是財政：博斯普魯斯的財富主要來自黑海沿岸的穀物、魚貨、獸皮與奴隸貿易，以及過境稅，這條線一斷，王廷就付不出常備軍的錢。第三層是權力交接的脆弱：斯巴達克王朝末期的繼承安排始終沒有穩定下來，國王對邊境將領與傭兵團的依賴過深。第四層是族群與城邦的摩擦：赫爾松涅斯這樣的希臘城邦在王國腹地爭奪土地、漁場與人口，兩者的邊界從未被清楚劃定，國王需要控制海峽，而城邦需要控制陸地與海港。於是常見的王朝末期劇本上演：國王用外來傭兵對付游牧壓力，傭兵在熟悉地形與糧道之後反噬雇主，叛軍再以解民倒懸為名拉攏城邦與部落，最後由第三方——密特里達斯一世——出面收拾殘局，順勢把王國變成自己的私產。戰事同時落在亞歷山大大帝死後的時代：後繼者諸王在敘利亞、美索不達米亞與小亞細亞互相攻殺，黑海北岸相對偏安，這個空白正是各方爭奪的窗口。
causeEn: The war was set off by several pressures arriving at once rather than by any single event. The first was foreign pressure: the Scythian tribal confederation, led by king Octamas, pushed southward and closed on the eastern frontier of the kingdom and on the pastoral and slave-supply lines of the Black Sea shore. The second was fiscal. The wealth of the Bosporus came from the export of grain, fish, hides and slaves from the Black Sea coast and from transit dues, and once that line was cut the royal court could no longer pay for a standing army. The third was the fragility of dynastic succession: the arrangements of the late Spartocid house were never settled, and the kings leaned too heavily on frontier commanders and mercenary companies. The fourth was friction between peoples and poleis: Chersonesus and its neighbours competed with the kingdom for land, fishing grounds and people, and the border between them had never been drawn, the king needing the strait and the polis needing the land and the harbours. The usual late-dynasty script then played out. The king hires foreign mercenaries to hold off nomad pressure; the mercenaries learn the terrain and the grain routes and turn on their employer; the rebels rally the towns and the tribes under the banner of relief from oppression; and a third party, Mithridates I, steps in to finish the business and keeps the kingdom for himself. The war also sits inside the age of the successors of Alexander the Great: the Diadochi were fighting each other over Syria, Mesopotamia and Asia Minor, and the northern Black Sea was relatively quiet, which is exactly the opening everyone was trying to seize.
impact: 這場內戰的直接結果，是博斯普魯斯的王朝更替：斯巴達克王朝在佩里斯阿德斯一世死後終結，密特里達斯王朝以聯姻與軍事介入入主，王國此後兩百多年由密特里達斯家族掌控，並在公元前二世紀把勢力伸向本都、黑海與地中海東岸。對黑海北岸的希臘世界而言，這是一場秩序的重排：赫爾松涅斯不但保住了城邦，還在事後取得自治與對城郊土地的正當權，成為黑海沿岸少數能以希臘城邦制度自立的城市；它組成的城邦聯盟此後在克里米亞西部形成一個長久的緩衝區，面對公元前二二〇年代斯基泰王阿特阿斯的南下，以及其後與密特里達斯六世相關的諸次衝突，赫爾松涅斯都站在前線。更大範圍的影響是黑海經濟地理的固化：從王國到城邦，穀物、鹽、鯡魚、魚子醬與奴隸的流向被戰爭重新談定，港口稅與護航成為常態，掠奪與反掠奪也變成黑海經濟的一部分。因此這場內戰並非無足輕重的宮廷政變，而是黑海世界從王國與城邦兩極對抗，走向王國、城邦與草原聯盟三方博弈的起點；密特里達斯王朝得以在黑海東岸立足，數百年後龐培的遠征才有登陸的對象。
impactEn: The direct outcome of the civil war was a change of dynasty in the Bosporus. With the death of Paerisades I the Spartocid line ended, the Mithridatic dynasty entered through marriage and military intervention, and for more than two hundred years afterwards the kingdom was in the hands of the Mithridates family, which in the second century BC pushed its power towards Pontus, the Black Sea and the eastern Mediterranean. For the Greek world of the northern coast this was a reordering of the whole arrangement. Chersonesus not only survived; it gained recognised autonomy and title to the land around its walls, and became one of the few cities on the Black Sea able to stand on its own under Greek civic institutions. The league it organised in western Crimea formed a durable buffer, and the city stood in the front line against the Scythian king Ateas in the 220s BC and, later, against the actions associated with Mithridates VI. The wider effect was the fixing of the Black Sea's economic geography. Between kingdom and polis the flow of grain, salt, herring, caviar and slaves was renegotiated as a result of the fighting; harbour dues and convoy escort became normal, and raiding and counter-raiding became part of the Black Sea economy. The civil war was therefore no inconsequential palace intrigue: it was the point at which the Black Sea world passed from a two-sided struggle between kingdom and poleis to a three-way contest between kingdom, polis and steppe confederation. The Mithridatic dynasty was able to establish itself on the eastern shore, and it was that presence which gave Pompey something to invade when he came east three centuries later.
result: 局面以狄俄尼索斯一方失敗告終。佩里斯阿德斯一世在逃往赫爾松涅斯之後去世，國王國的東岸城市先後被守軍與城邦聯盟奪回，狄俄尼索斯據守的城池最終失守，他本人被逐出博斯普魯斯；其殘部或散歸草原，或隨密特里達斯進入新王朝的軍隊。密特里達斯一世以救援者的身分接管王國，娶佩里斯阿德斯一系的女性以取得王位的合法性，把博斯普魯斯變成密特里達斯家族的私產，並保留博斯普魯斯的希臘城市、港口與多瑙河下游的穀物通道。赫爾松涅斯作為付出代價的一方換來實惠：城邦保住領土與自治，取得對周邊部落貿易的保障，並在往後兩百年間成為黑海北岸唯一持續使用希臘制度的重要城市。同時這場內戰留下三個長尾：王廷對傭兵的依賴沒有被徹底糾正，王國與赫爾松涅斯之間的邊界爭議依舊，而黑海航線從此被視為必須用船隊與同盟守住的戰略資產。史家記載殘缺，這裡能確定的只是結局的方向：王權由一個王朝交到另一個王朝，僭主被逐出，城邦得到喘息，而亞述式長弓所代表的弓箭傳統，繼續在黑海兩岸的戰場上服役數百年。
resultEn: The affair ended in the defeat of Dionysius. Paerisades I died after his flight to Chersonesus, the eastern cities of the kingdom were retaken one by one by their garrisons and by the league of the poleis, the city where Dionysius had entrenched himself finally fell, and he himself was driven out of the Bosporus; his remaining men either scattered into the steppe or entered the army of the new dynasty. Mithridates I took the kingdom in the guise of a rescuer, married into the line of Paerisades to legitimise his claim, turned the Bosporus into the private possession of the Mithridates family, and kept the Greek cities, the harbours and the grain road of the lower Danube. Chersonesus, having paid for the war, took its reward: the polis kept its territory and its autonomy, obtained guarantees for its trade with the neighbouring tribes, and for the next two centuries remained the one major city of the northern Black Sea coast to run on Greek institutions. The civil war left three long tails as well. The court's dependence on mercenaries was never fully corrected; the boundary dispute between the kingdom and Chersonesus remained open; and the Black Sea lane came to be treated as a strategic asset that had to be held with shipping and alliances. The record is fragmentary, and what can be certain is the direction of the outcome: the crown passed from one dynasty to another, the usurper was expelled, the polis drew breath, and the archery tradition represented by the Assyrian bow on the card went on serving on the battlefields of both shores of the Black Sea for centuries.
